english.note: Use this when a liquid falls in drops; it is the straightforward choice for liquid rather than saliva or a ball.

exampleSentences.english: A little water continues to dribble from the tap.
exampleSentences.traditional: 水喉漏水，啲水一滴一滴咁滴落嚟。
exampleSentences.jyutping: seoi2 hau4 lau6 seoi2 di1 seoi2 jat1 dik6 jat1 dik6 gam3 dik6 lok6 lai4

english.note: Use 滴 specifically when liquid falls one drop or droplet at a time.

exampleSentences.english: I watched water drop from the tap one drop at a time.
exampleSentences.traditional: 水喉仲一滴一滴咁滴緊水。
exampleSentences.jyutping: seoi2 hau4 zung6 jat1 dik6 jat1 dik6 gam2 dik6 gan2 seoi2
